First fix (d5b1dd5) addressed scripts/build_arena.sh but real CI still failed on a third, separate build path -- the Windows cross-compile step inline in ci.yml, also missing bloodflower_mod.c. Fixed and, this time, verified locally BEFORE pushing (downloaded the real SDL2-devel-2.30.10-mingw package, ran the actual mingw cross-compile with the fix applied, clean build). Commit e3b359c. Confirmed via the real GitHub Actions API result: conclusion=success.

⚓ ☃
title: REDGARDEN CI confirmed green -- second fix needed, verified for real this time
